author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
Having spread DEMOCRACY to the Orbital protecting this backwater Dynasty world, the humans descend in their dropships to take the fight to this clanker infested planet in the hopes of shackling and making off with one of their AI's to chart a jump home. 

The forces of the Eternal Dynasty have to hold out until rescue arrives as the HDF secures their foothold on the planet. 

Check out all the rules free HERE: https://onepagerules.com/games/grimdark-future
